Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: not_implemented.
Assessment: Contract dependency correctly prevents minting authority from input JSON/receipts.
Staleness: Open dependency-waiting status is truthful; no expiry inferred from age.
Remaining / next action: Implement the accepted U1 trust model through existing local publication/cache/resume seams, with scoped producer/consumer and refusal courts.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Outcome: the approved U1 contract is implemented in ordinary-file configuration, preparation, paired/weighted export and the local workspace consumer.

Paths: the U1-owned pipeline boundaries, examples/mapping readers where wire changes are needed, public CLI guides and focused test suites. Reuse existing admission and mapping implementations; avoid a second inference path.

Acceptance:
1. A non-Sherlock study with independently authored source and recall files reaches both reference/reconstruction and three structural weights through the installed command. It is not admitted by hard-coding its content as another special synthetic control.
2. Authority and exact rendered-text identity survive preparation/segmentation and every requested export. Missing, mismatched, forged and widened-scope inputs refuse before creating a completed publication. Resume checks exact bytes and a changed study/settings/authority cannot reuse an old receipt.
3. Existing local-only analysis, certified inputs, project controls and Sherlock routes retain their documented behavior. Text, key material and private paths do not leak through diagnostics. A local result grants neither repository redistribution nor hosted API permission.
4. Named regression and compiled mutation controls distinguish each new guarantee; checked constructors receive external-package positive-controlled boundary probes where applicable. Run the scoped producer and affected StoryAtlas gates, plus documentation examples and independent Python readers. Preserve wire/source compatibility or supply the reviewed migration explicitly.

Next action: implement only the reviewed U1 contract, after its acceptance passes. Stop on a contract ambiguity rather than minting authority from a caller boolean.

Evidence and completion: keep exact baseline/candidate SHA, input and artifact hashes, literal commands and actual exits, passed/failed/skipped totals, initial adverse evidence, and independent exact-SHA review. Runtime changes use tools/reference-scope.sh in a clean standalone clone, fatal warnings, all affected platforms and the pinned StoryAtlas consumer where consumed; formatting runs last. Documentation/tracker-only changes use a format/integrity check and cold review (T2). One primary writer, one helper and one heavy gate at a time. Claim only the slice and reserve its narrow paths. No percentage-complete or efficacy claim follows from ticket/test counts.
